id: lc3-无重复字符的最长子串
title: 3 无重复字符的最长子串
code:
class Solution:
    def lengthOfLongestSubstring(self, s: str) -> int:
        visited = set()
        left = 0
        maxLen = 0
        for right, ch in enumerate(s): # 闭区间窗口 [left, right]
            while ch in visited:
                visited.remove(s[left])
                left += 1
            visited.add(ch)
            maxLen = max(maxLen, right - left + 1)
        return maxLen
